authorization.scope: captain-authorized exact terminal verification/rebaseline diagnostic only
authorization.purpose: Verify native AMD64 ordering and record architecture-specific rebaseline evidence without exposing the terminal holdout to any optimizer, campaign phase, model, or exploratory run.

run.command: HONE_CAPSULE_DIR=capsules/tree-sitter-parse HONE_TERMINAL_HOLDOUT_DIAGNOSTIC=1 pnpm exec tsx capsules/tools/ordering-check.ts --holdout-diagnostic --stability-runs 5 --raw-measurements tmp/rebaseline/tree-sitter-parse.json --report capsules/tree-sitter-parse/diagnostics/ordering-report.amd64.json

blocker.exactFailure: candidate runtime failed to compile: generated harness.c hard-errors that trusted exit and trusted control channel are pinned to linux/arm64
blocker.requiredDecision: Future captain authorization must migrate the protected evaluator's architecture-specific raw syscall harness. This lane must not edit protected evaluator, baseline, or asset bytes.
blocker.historicalArm64Evidence: retained with its original architecture label; not relabelled as AMD64
